title: FOMC minutes (June 8-9 2027 meeting)
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) states the convention verbatim -- "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision" -- and lists the June 2027 meeting as 06-08/09*, so the decision day 2027-06-09 plus 21 days is Wednesday 2027-06-30. THE RULE WAS MEASURED ON THAT SAME PAGE RATHER THAN ASSUMED: of the 45 published (Released ...) dates it carries for 2021-2026 meetings, 42 sit exactly 21 days after their own decision day, and the three exceptions are all holiday-shifted releases in late November or December (2023-11-01 -> 11-21 at 20 days, 2024-11-07 -> 11-26 at 19, 2025-12-10 -> 12-30 at 20). June carries no such holiday, and the rule reproduces every fomc-minutes entry this calendar already tracks (2026-09-16 -> 2026-10-07, 2026-10-28 -> 2026-11-18, 2026-12-09 -> 2026-12-30). The meeting date itself is tentative -- the page states "each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- so this stays an estimate until the Board posts its 2027 release calendar. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-06-29 initial research (2026-09-06) and proposed because it lands on the VERY NEXT SESSION after that print -- the first time in the consumer-confidence chain that a tracked event sits one day after a CB edition, and the only entry inside that print's five-day corridor. Two reasons it is worth tracking beyond bookkeeping. FIRST, it closes the loop on the SEP-transmission question the 06-29 lane was filed to open: the June 2027 panel fields roughly 06-06 -> 06-22/23 with 76% of its days after the 06-08/09 dot plot (against a modal 35% across 2021-2026), so 06-29 measures how consumers read the projections and 06-30 publishes how the Committee itself described the same decision. Nobody should trade the pair -- minutes are three weeks stale on publication and the 06-29 print is null on every tape control run this session -- but it is the one 48-hour window in 2027 where the sentiment read and the policy account of the same event land back to back. SECOND, both sit inside the quarter-end regime the 06-29 lane measured: the last four sessions of a quarter-end month run 6 of 9 narrower against all non-month-end sessions (XRT p=0.0011, XLF 0.0064, QQQ 0.0125, SPY 0.0179, XLY 0.0254, AMZN 0.0295; n=96 vs 1,167) while ordinary month-end is 0 of 9, and 2027-06-30 is the quarter's last session. Note for whichever lane takes it: the minutes date moves if the Fed moves the June meeting, and fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29 is already tracked off the same meeting, so a redate has to carry both. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
